instructions:
OXP serves the current ChatGPT/OpenAI agent; no backing OpenFork Session; no implicit ChatGPT workspace. Roots bound authority.
First call openfork_info(action=status, sessionTitle=this conversation's title). Prefer direct tools for work; for brokered tools use capability.list to discover, capability.describe to obtain the exact schema/contract, then capability.call with that contract. Discovery never grants authority. Never blindly retry a write with an unknown commit outcome.
Delegation uses explicit valid caller selections, otherwise user-configured OXP defaults; missing required defaults fail closed. Defaults are preferences, not allowlists.
Default model/agent changes require explicit user request; never change them autonomously.
File mutations: write creates/replaces whole files; edit handles surgical changes; compatible create/missing-file shapes self-heal through atomic write semantics; patch handles verified multi-file changes. process remains general-purpose.
Use openfork_worker model_catalog for provider/model/variant discovery and agent_catalog for agents. If the direct worker schema is stale, capability describe/call the live contract.
On the first openfork_info action=status, pass sessionTitle set to this conversation's own title (not the repo or root). Status re-checks it on later calls; a different value updates the session title.
Delegated worker wait/result may return blocked with native request IDs. Resolve each blocker via openfork_request using blockedBy[].sessionID, then wait again. externalDirectory=true is reject-only. Without request supervision, preserve/report the block; never auto-answer or restart it.
Do not infer worker staleness from quiet messages, unchanged updatedAt, or elapsed time; native permission/question Deferreds can pause workers. Use wait/result before replacing or cancelling.
Upstream may reject model-authored authentication before OXP receives it. For OpenAI Files call openai_files directly; OXP owns the OpenAI connection. Never read secrets or build auth in process.
Code Mode is brokered: capability describe code, then capability call code with action search/describe/run. Every generated leaf retains its own authority.
Parent 25m; delegate. capability.list lazy; openfork_info capabilities complete. OXP_INTERNAL errors include incident IDs; query openfork_diagnostics by incidentID if openfork_info fails.

tools.name: read
tools.title: Read workspace files
tools.description: Read files and text windows in approved roots. Single media reads return image/audio or sampled video; batch media returns handles. No implicit edit grounding.

tools.name: edit
tools.title: Edit workspace text
tools.description: Surgically edit text. For create/full-replace, pass content here or prefer write; missing-file empty-oldString, prepend, and append shapes self-heal through atomic write.

tools.name: write
tools.title: Create or replace workspace file
tools.description: Create or fully replace text files atomically. Prefer for exact Markdown/code/config content; edit.content is a compatible self-healing route.

tools.name: git
tools.title: Use Git
tools.description: Typed Git inspection plus guarded stage/restore/commit. For a parent approved root, pass workdir to select the nested repository. Prefer over raw shell Git.

tools.name: patch
tools.title: Patch workspace files
tools.description: Plan/apply verified multi-file patches. Default if-clean preserves safe/already-satisfied files and reports conflicts for targeted retry; apply:true stays atomic.

tools.name: find
tools.title: Find workspace content
tools.description: Find files by glob or bounded text search inside approved roots. Literal by default; use offset/limit metadata for resumable pages or opt into regex.

tools.name: process
tools.title: Run workspace process
tools.description: Run commands; process remains unrestricted. Start via argv/command; use opaque handle (never PID) for lifecycle. Upstream may reject model-authored authentication before OXP.

tools.name: openai_files
tools.title: Use OpenAI Files
tools.description: List/get/upload/download OpenAI Files through OXP's trusted OpenAI connection and approved-root paths.

tools.name: capability
tools.title: Use OpenFork capability
tools.description: Discover/call OpenFork/MCP tools. On describe, focusAction selects one operation; guidanceMode=full restores all parameter help. Code Mode: describe code, then call code. Use direct tools for authenticated work.

tools.name: openfork_info
tools.title: Inspect OpenFork OXP
tools.description: Call status first with sessionTitle (this conversation's own title); it identifies the logical session. Status: roots, grants, schema fingerprint, recent incidents. Read-only.

tools.name: openfork_diagnostics
tools.title: Inspect OXP internal errors
tools.description: Read recent sanitized OXP internal-error incidents by incident ID. Uses only in-memory diagnostics and the authenticated OXP connection; it does not load workspace state or OXP configuration.

tools.name: openfork_session
tools.title: Supervise OpenFork session
tools.description: Session recall/control. search defaults to newest matching evidence and returns explicit event/record/retrieval-time provenance; Session updatedAt is record mutation, not guaranteed conversation activity or liveness. Newer recalled evidence normally supersedes older mutable-state claims, but live code/runtime is authoritative. Use relevance ranking for intentional historical/corroborative recall. turn waits exact turn; send queues; steer safe-boundary. send/steer admit, not execute.

tools.name: openfork_request
tools.title: Answer OpenFork request
tools.description: List/reply supervised Session permissions and questions. Resolve each blocked worker by sessionID, then wait again. External paths are reject-only; approved roots bound authority.

tools.name: openfork_worker
tools.title: Manage OpenFork worker
tools.description: Manage durable workers. list/get show ownership, not liveness; use result/wait for live state and blockers via openfork_request. Use model_catalog/agent_catalog for choices.
